the elementary spin excitations in the transverse-field Isign-like antiferromagnet can be described by the Schr\"odinging equation in the confined regime and by a quantum field theory of fermions in the disordered regime.
the elementary excitations in a 1D quantum spin model can be classified into three categories: confined spinons, emergent fermions, and collective spin excitations.
